countries.reasoning: Based on recent USGS and industry reports, China dominates silicon carbide production globally due to extensive electric furnace capacity and multiple producers. Data is recent and reliable.
USGS and industry data indicate the US is a leading producer with several major silicon carbide manufacturing facilities. Data is reliable but production has slight annual volatility.
Norway's production is well-documented through industrial reports and national statistics. Data is fairly recent but Norway's share is smaller relative to China and the US.
Industry sources show Brazil as an important producer of silicon carbide in South America. Data is accurate though less comprehensive compared to major producers.
Russia produces significant silicon carbide volumes, supported by government and industry production data. Some uncertainty due to geopolitical factors affecting data transparency.
